questions.question: Why does Jeremiah wish his eyes were a fountain of tears in chapter 9?
options: To lament the great famine spreading across the land
To grieve deeply over the sudden death of the king
To mourn the loss of his own family and his kin
To weep day and night for the slain of his people
questions.answer: To weep day and night for the slain of his people

questions.question: In what does God say a person should boast, according to Jeremiah 9?
options: That he is far wiser than all of the counselors and the elders gathered in the whole of the land
That his great strength and his might far surpass that of every other mighty and seasoned warrior
That all of his riches and his many treasures are greater than those of any king now alive on earth
That he understands and knows the LORD, who practices steadfast love, justice, and righteousness
questions.answer: That he understands and knows the LORD, who practices steadfast love, justice, and righteousness

questions.question: Jeremiah 9 is sometimes called the lament of the 'weeping prophet.'
Let not the wise man boast in his wisdom... but let him who boasts boast in this, that he understands and knows _____.
Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a fountain of _____!
